scope: Inventory of existing source-map records and mathematical coordinate comparison; no surveyed checkpoints or visual acceptance.

runtimeCoordinateFrame.axes: x east, y up, z south; metres; river 0 m, island 2 m
runtimeCoordinateFrame.horizontalMethod: 111320 metres per degree, longitude scaled by cosine of origin latitude
runtimeCoordinateFrame.verticalDatum: Game-relative river 0 m / island 2 m; not NAVD88 or ellipsoidal height

roads.interpretation: sourceWidth records preserve earlier imported/derived width, not necessarily survey measurements. build-mainland.mjs assigns municipal road widths by name. Preserve gameplay clearance until a separately tested road/collision migration.

buildings.interpretation: The current generator assigns 6.8 m to added City footprints. Missing per-building height evidence does not mean every other height is invented; it means this audit cannot certify its provenance.

terrain.interpretation: Elmwood grid is resampled into the game-relative frame. Jefferson mainland is rendered separately at a constant game elevation. No absolute vertical datum is established by this grid.

projectionModelComparison.reference: WGS84 ECEF to local ENU; both geographic input and origin use ellipsoidal height 0 for the horizontal comparison only.
projectionModelComparison.interpretation: Coordinate-model difference reconstructed from existing map points, NOT real-world positional error, independent survey residual, correction offsets, or a reason to move only one district.
projectionModelComparison.sampling: Existing road/building/outline vertices, including repeated ring endpoints; not uniformly spaced spatial samples. Median averages the middle pair; p95 uses nearest rank.

bridge.interpretation: Distances between current authored endpoints; neither establishes measured bridge deck length or grade.

nextEvidence: Independent control locations with source, acquisition date, horizontal uncertainty and CRS.
Ground DEM tiles with actual delivered horizontal/vertical CRS, units, datum transform and coverage.
Building-specific roof height, facade and footprint observations with rights to reuse source imagery.
Measured road widths, curb lines, bridge deck and shore/seawall geometry separated from ground.
Matched camera captures plus unchanged collision, accessibility and native performance acceptance.

provenance.note: The input hashes identify the inspected bytes; baseRevision alone does not assert a clean working tree.
